name: Brown and Brown Farms and Country Store
tagline: Brown & Brown’s Country Store – Brown's Adventure Farm
description: Brown and Brown Farms and Country Store grows Strawberries, Corn, and Honey in Oxford, FL. The farm is independent, and its seasons run through spring. The harvest is typically at its peak in spring. Check the website or call ahead for current hours and what is in season.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Apr – Jun in this growing zone.
